tools.name: plumsail_get_profile
tools.description: Return the Plumsail account profile: name, email, team, licence status, plan type, remaining credits and expiry date. Use it to check the connection and the plan limits.

tools.name: plumsail_list_processes
tools.description: List the document generation processes configured in the account, with their ids and settings as Plumsail returns them. Use the id with plumsail_get_process_tokens.

tools.name: plumsail_get_process_tokens
tools.description: List the tokens (placeholders) used in a process's template: label, type and key. Use the keys as the fields of the data you pass to a generate call.

tools.name: plumsail_generate_document
tools.description: Fill a DOCX or XLSX template with data and return a link to the result file. Each call uses one document from the account's monthly plan. The output type is the vendor default. Results must finish within 30 seconds; large files may fail.

tools.name: plumsail_convert_to_pdf
tools.description: Convert a DOCX, XLSX or PPTX file to PDF and return a link to the PDF. Each call uses one document from the account's monthly plan. Results must finish within 30 seconds.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: plumsail_get_profile · Private data: plumsail_list_processes, plumsail_get_process_tokens, plumsail_generate_document, plumsail_convert_to_pdf · Public sink: plumsail_get_profile.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: plumsail_get_profile · Private data: plumsail_list_processes, plumsail_get_process_tokens, plumsail_generate_document, plumsail_convert_to_pdf · Public sink: plumsail_get_profile

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
